# Pixel Notes App

A simple offline notes app with three tabs: **Work**, **Home**, and **Ideas**. Each tab has its own text area that preserves content when switching tabs. The active tab is highlighted, and a character count is shown for each tab.

## Features

- Three tabs with independent text areas
- Content preserved per tab when switching
- Active tab highlighted
- Character count updates live per tab
- Keyboard accessible (arrow keys, Home/End, focus states)
- Responsive layout down to 360px
- No external dependencies or network requests

## Usage

Open `index.html` in any modern browser. No build step or server required.

## Files

- `index.html` — main markup
- `styles.css` — styling and layout
- `app.js` — tab switching and character count logic

## Accessibility

- Tabs use proper ARIA roles (`tablist`, `tab`, `tabpanel`)
- Labels for each text area (visually hidden)
- Keyboard navigation: Arrow Left/Right, Home, End
- Visible focus indicators

## Browser Support

Works in Chrome, Firefox, Edge, and Safari (modern versions).
